title: Create: Enhanced Adventures+
description: This modpack was made to allow those who have bad computers and those who like create mods to play their games without lag with vanilla+ mods.
body: The main purpose of this modpack is to collect the best vanilla+ mods and combine them with create mods, optimize and adjust them to provide a smooth gaming experience. All settings of the modpack have been made, it is ready to offer you the most optimized gaming experience. Regular updates will be made and the comments will definitely be taken into consideration. If you have any requests or questions, you can comment.
